svg.title: Chatbot evaluation
svg.desc: Each of 23 gold-set questions is asked as a fresh single turn. The run records the answer and every tool call with its result, then checks tool selection, advice and scope behaviour, citation warnings, input guards and unverified figures. A person reads the transcript for number correctness and evidence relevance. A frozen set, retrieval metrics, an LLM judge, a usability questionnaire and multi-turn scenarios are planned.
